input: Huge pothole on Elm Street near the bus stop, getting deeper every week.
The road surface caved in at 5th and Main and cars are bottoming out.
Asphalt is crumbling around the manhole cover on 3rd Avenue.
Pothole in the bike lane on River Road, right where cyclists merge.
There is a deep hole in the street by the elementary school entrance.
Crews tore up the road in March and never repaved it; it is all gravel now.
Streetlight is out at the corner of Oak and 9th and the block is pitch black.
The lamp on our block flickers on and off all night long.
A light pole got knocked down in the storm and there are wires on the ground.
The street light at 1200 Pine Street has been dead for a week.
The bulb in the street lamp shattered and there is glass on the sidewalk.
Someone dumped a mattress and a set of tires in the alley behind Vine Street.
The trash bins at the park entrance are overflowing and trash is blowing across the lawn.
Our garbage pickup was missed again on Thursday, third time this month.
Bags of litter are scattered along the creek trail near the footbridge.
Construction debris has been sitting on the vacant lot for two months.
Water main break at 7th and Walnut, the street is flooding fast.
The fire hydrant on our corner has been leaking steadily since Tuesday.
Brown water is coming out of all our taps since this morning.
The storm drain is clogged and the intersection floods every time it rains.
A pipe burst in front of 44 Birch Lane and there is water everywhere.
Loud party with amplified music going past 2 a.m. every weekend.
A construction crew starts jackhammering at 5 a.m., hours before the permitted time.
A car alarm has been going off for six hours straight on our street.
A dog is left outside barking all night, third night in a row.
Graffiti tags are all over the underpass wall again.
Someone spray-painted the entire side of the public library.
Fresh tagging showed up on the playground equipment at Central Park.
An abandoned car with two flat tires has not moved in three weeks.
A vehicle is blocking my driveway every morning on Cedar Street.
